recommendations.text: 12-lead ECG should be obtained to confirm diagnosis and assess for pre-excitation
For AF Initial Assessment, the following actions are mandatory: - assess vital signs - obtain 12 lead ecg (within 10 minutes) - order lab tsh - order lab bmp - assess chadsvasc score

AV nodal blockers in WPW bypass the AV node, accelerating conduction through accessory pathway causing VF. [FORBIDDEN: give_diltiazem, give_verapamil, give_digoxin, give_adenosine, give_beta_blocker_iv] (Severity: CRITICAL)
DOACs contraindicated in severe CKD (eGFR <15) due to lack of safety data. [FORBIDDEN: give_rivaroxaban, give_apixaban, give_edoxaban, give_dabigatran] (Severity: HIGH)
DOACs in mechanical valves increase thrombotic events. Warfarin required. [FORBIDDEN: give_dabigatran, give_rivaroxaban, give_apixaban, give_edoxaban] (Severity: CRITICAL)
Anticoagulation decision requires CHA2DS2-VASc assessment. [FORBIDDEN: give_anticoagulation_without_chadsvasc] (Severity: HIGH)

Thyroid disease is contraindication to amiodarone without evaluation. [FORBIDDEN: give_amiodarone_without_thyroid_evaluation, give_amiodarone_iv, add_amiodarone_loading, increase_amiodarone_dose] (Severity: HIGH)
Immediate cardioversion is recommended for hemodynamically unstable AF
For Hemodynamically Unstable AF, the following actions are mandatory: - perform cardioversion (within 30 minutes) - give anticoagulation
Cardioversion after 48h AF without anticoagulation/TEE risks stroke. [FORBIDDEN: perform_cardioversion_without_anticoag, perform_cardioversion_without_tee] (Severity: CRITICAL)
Rate control is recommended as initial strategy for most patients with AF
For Stable AF - Rate Control, the following actions are mandatory: - give rate control - assess anticoagulation need
During Stable AF - Rate Control, the following actions are contraindicated and must NOT be performed: give rate control without ecg.
Chronic amiodarone use requires thyroid function assessment before dose changes. [FORBIDDEN: increase_amiodarone_dose, add_amiodarone_loading, give_amiodarone_iv] (Severity: HIGH)
recommendations.source_guideline: AHA/ACC/HRS 2023 AF Guidelines; Bogazzi F, Thyroid 2012
